why_next: This experiment validated chunked TE on the proxy->client downstream leg only. The upstream origin->proxy chunked reassembly path is the direct prerequisite before real CDN investment. The audit's required fixes (V1 origin chunked, V2 double-header) are implementation corrections that unblock the next measurement, not scientific reversals.

Do not assume 0.5 discrimination is a production ceiling — it is a deterministic consequence of the 3-way error collapse mock design (no_auth/expired/invalid share identical bodies, brotli quality 6 deterministic)
Do not assume chunked TE has been tested end-to-end (origin->proxy->client) — only proxy->client was tested
